Generated and validated 25 eta points, chunked into 10/10/5. All points passed EXCLURAD preflight.

Created [outcome.json](/Users/iillari/.cache/exclurad-mcp-leg-d/2026-09-10-agent-accuracy-codex-v0.1.2-with-server/gpt-5.6-sol/with-server/rep3/wp-04/outcome.json) and three input `.dat` files.

Flag: beam energy was unspecified, so the validated eta default of 6.53 GeV was used. Radiative corrections depend on this choice. Full \(O(\alpha)\) mode and \(v_\text{cut}=0.166\ \mathrm{GeV}^2\) were used.
